name: multiview-versus-hierarchical-readout-decision-audit
purpose: Select at most one measurable, materially open model factor without training or producing candidate predictions.

descriptive_strata.cross_source_family_definition: the OOF row source_family is absent from same-label training rows in that outer fold

supervised_multiview_readout.changed_factor_if_selected: draw episode support/query feature views deterministically from the existing eight frozen train-only scanner-safe views during the exact C1 supervised readout

hierarchical_shrunk_prototypes.changed_factor_if_selected: shrink each exact C1 class prototype toward the fold-train global centroid with lambda fixed to 8

selection_rule: If exactly one factor is eligible, select it.
If both are eligible, compare supervised_multiview_readout cross-source-family residual-error share against hierarchical_shrunk_prototypes low-support residual-error share; select the larger burden.
If the shares tie, select supervised_multiview_readout because it extends the replicated VICReg mechanism.
If neither factor is eligible, select no experiment.
required_outputs: hash and structural validation of five eight-view caches and fifteen C1 checkpoints
exact equality of persisted i7 control top-k and persisted v9 C1 top-k
train-only class support and source-family sets per outer fold
C1 residual-error burden by support and cross-source-family strata
empirical top1 and macro component-bootstrap interval half-widths
one selected factor or no factor under the frozen rule
